screens.caption: The desktop: your ACRYL apps as icons, a dock, menus, and the ACRYL chat beside it
The chat made a folder and moved Notes into it: tool steps cost 0 tokens, model steps show the provider's tokens
Files: the Sales folder the chat made, with Notes in it
The run, saved as a workflow: Run again repeats it with no model call
Activity: each app's memory and processes, read from the computer
Settings: wallpaper, icons, dock, chat, and how long an unused app waits before it sleeps
